description: EOLES elec (Energy Optimization for Low Emission Systems - electricity) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by CIRED. The EOLES family of models optimizes the investment and operation of an energy system. Coverage: user-defined regions (as stated on the fact sheet). The fact sheet classes it as: Electricity System Model,. Sectors: Electricity Sector, Carbon Market,. Resolution: time Hour, geography Country level. Data availability is given as "all". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0 (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
